image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a circular aneroid barometer with a gold-colored metallic casing. The face is white with black text and markings, featuring weather indicators ('STORMY', 'RAIN', 'CHANGE', 'FAIR', 'VERY DRY') and pressure scales in both millibars (outer ring) and inches of mercury (inner ring). A central cutout reveals the internal brass mechanical movement (gears and springs). There are two pointer hands: a thin black indicator hand and a thicker brass reference hand. A faint 'dreamstime' watermark is visible across the center.
